summary: Round-3 long-tail repair: 69 of the 86 refusing identities repaired through shared paths, each executed-and-compared at 1 and 4 workers; 7 classes (17 identities) remain located refusals inside the declared surface. (1) allocation 66->0 (21 operators): the allocator's victim selection now targets the failing point's SIMULTANEOUSLY LIVE set preferring the MOST-USED candidate (a long range's dissolution relieves every failing point it crosses; the old failed-first policy burned all 64 rounds rematerializing single-use constants while ~20 long-lived descriptor/stride/pointer values carried 26-31 live values everywhere), rematerialized originals are pruned once dead (a dead def still demanded a register -- phantom pressure), vector-spill legality matches the emitter's actual contract (every CONSTANT-avl region restores via vsetivli, not only avl==vlmax -- forward_pass_chunks' partial-vl tails), and vsetvli AVL operands are never split (a reload as AVL would de-constantize the region a spill must restore). (2) convert 2->0: fp16/bf16<->fp64 routes (a subnormal Python float literal types fp64 under the pinned to_tensor rule and promotes tl.maximum's chain; the 16-bit data rides exact 16->32->64 widening and doubly-RTNE narrowing back). (3) mir-verifier 1->0: the bool->fp16 select opens the destination's own region (the unbracketed vsel ran v16m1 values in the pass's e32 region). Three latent EXECUTION defects the first executions exposed, all fixed and executed-and-compared: the fp64 rsqrt's dividend splat passed the raw bit pattern 0x3ff0000000000000 to _splat_const which encodes float VALUES (renorm's whole chain multiplied by ~4.6e18, every dtype); a SCALAR pointer carry whose back edge is p+=s was classified plain-scalar before the recurrence check, so its body-end ptradd bound to the param and the back edge passed it unchanged -- the loop read the FIRST iteration's address forever (forward_pass_chunks); and WTI035's open naive_attn QEMU SIGILL was the allocator placing an indexed load's destination inside its index's IMPLIED EMUL group (an EEW=64 index beside an e32m1 access reads a two-register group; probed on the pinned QEMU: any data register inside the group, load or store, masked or not, is an illegal instruction) -- the allocator now reserves the implied width, aligned, and the data side avoids the group. Filtered sweep over the 48 owned operators at rev b0907986d16aba19: 233 identities, 216 artifacts (baseline 147), 17 located refusals, 0 crashes, all sweep checks PASS. Remaining classes: tl.sort 6, tl.cumsum/cumprod 3, merge 3, tl.histogram 2, tl.dot 1, layout 1, ptradd 1 -- all constructs INSIDE the declared surface (their FRONTEND_COVERAGE rows are 'implemented' for other forms), so they are honest not-yet-implemented refusals, not declared-unsupported classifications; acceptance[0] is therefore not met. naive_attn now executes PASS at 1 worker (all dtypes) but still diverges at 4 workers (a separate pre-existing multi-worker partition defect in its varlen-gather path, same artifact at both thread counts).
